bull_argument.argument:
Nvidia reported Q2 revenue of $96.2bn, up 106%, directly substantiating AI infrastructure demand. Exceptional operating margins, positive FCF and low gross leverage make the earnings-growth case materially stronger than an unproven thematic story.

The 14.02x forward multiple and inconsistent snapshot earnings bases must be reconciled, so the buy argument does not depend on that quote proving cheapness. The longer uptrend survives short-term weakness; verified normalized earnings and consolidation could support staged growth exposure. Statement periods and forward estimates remain undated, so conviction is conditional.

bear_argument.argument:
The apparently low 14.02x forward multiple is an undated estimate; trailing P/E 27.63x conflicts with market-cap/profit at 43.90x. Customer capital economics and demand durability remain pivotal despite exceptional margins.

Four consecutive declines have brought price below SMA20 while SMA50 and SMA200 remain underneath; the longer trend survives but short-term momentum is deteriorating. The price evidence does not independently establish an attractive immediate allocation. The bull case is conditional on further operating or financial confirmation; those conditions should gate new capital rather than be treated as facts already proved.
